reviews.reviewer: Codex incident repair; independent Standards and Spec review before merge
reviews.rationale: Preserve the canonical gate workflow and validate both supported workflow filenames on every run. Require review for included source deletion or blank truncation and JSONC cron changes, while permitting reviewed large/symlink removals and stale manifest cleanup without blob or target reads.

controls.request_bound: 0 application or provider requests are added. Gate inspection remains local Git reads bounded to 3000 changed files and 2 MiB per inspected blob.
controls.fanout_bound: 1 existing cost-safety job per pull-request event; no new workflow, scheduled job or deployment command is added.
controls.termination: The existing job terminates after five minutes; each Git subprocess terminates after thirty seconds. Real-Git tests use disposable repositories.
controls.failure_behavior: Missing canonical workflow and unsafe alternate gate workflow metadata fail even with acknowledgement. Included source deletion requires a current empty digest and cited regression evidence.

reviews.rationale: This installs the reviewed change-risk gate and its documentation; it enforces current review evidence, not semantic application traffic bounds.

controls.request_bound: 0 application or provider requests are made by this review gate; git reads are bounded to 3000 changed files.
controls.fanout_bound: 1 serial gate process per CI run; no application code or review-supplied command is executed.
controls.termination: The CI job stops after five minutes; each git command has a thirty-second timeout and no retry loop.

reviews.rationale: This records cost-review instructions in the root policy. The section creates no application requests or jobs; existing application workflows need their own verification.

controls.request_bound: 0 application or provider requests are introduced by this policy change; the new cost gate only reads local Git objects and cited tracked test files.
controls.fanout_bound: 1 new cost-safety job runs per pull-request event. This review makes no request or job-fanout claim about existing application CI.
controls.termination: The new cost-safety job has a five-minute timeout and each gate Git command a thirty-second timeout. Policy text executes no code; existing application CI is separate.
controls.failure_behavior: Missing or stale controls or regression evidence fail the new gate. Root-policy changes and removal require current acknowledgement; existing CI failures remain independent.
